description: In a well-order of uncountable cofinality, a set is nonstationary exactly when its complement belongs to the club filter.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.nonstationary_iff_compl_mem.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  (hα : Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α) (S : Set α) : ¬IsStationary S ↔ Sᶜ ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.clubFilter α
